name: Project Kuiper
tagline: Amazon LEO broadband — 3236 sats planned, ramping 2024+
description: Amazon's planned answer to Starlink — 3,236 satellites at 590-630 km in 98 orbital planes. First operational launches began in 2023; FCC license requires 50% deployment by July 2026 and 100% by July 2029. Customer integration aimed at Amazon's AWS ground-station service. Will roughly double the LEO active-satellite population if fully deployed.
